lines: A further two days later――The day of the event.
Announcer
『――Thank you for waiting, everyone. I present the voting results!』
Announcer
『The coveted first place in the 24th Autumn Street Food Contest, sponsored by the Senzaki Shopkeepers' Association, is―――』
A public park, Senzaki.
Under the gentle autumn sunlight, the cooking contest had ended on a high note.
Girl 1
「Wasn't that tasty～, Akiyama-san?♪ Especially that crab fried rice from the stand that won!」
Girl 2
「Um-hmm. There were lots of other appetizing stalls, too. Let's make sure to bring everyone with us next year!」
Some girls passed by, while chatting in apparent satisfaction.
It looked like the dangerous criminal city of Senzaki had made an exception just for today.
People who had nothing to do with the fighting had turned out in large numbers, sights set on the cooking that would be served in the contest.
Library
（My, my...... I've managed to fulfill my role one way or another.）
Library breathed a sigh of relief as he gazed at the flow of people.
If the ingredients used were of the same grade, then the chef's skill meant everything.
Library's cooking had triumphed magnificently, due as well to the use of the Monster Crab, the rare ingredient that Erika had gone to get.
The result was that they had surpassed the dishes that the Francis Family served by a slim margin.
Erika
「Good job, Library-san! How do I say it?――I'm truly grateful for this!!!」
Library
「Not at all. I myself am glad I could be of help.」
Library
「In the first place, we would probably have lost, if not for the ingredient you went to get.」
Erika
「Then it's everyone's win! Aha, we did it!!」
Erika
「Now we won't have to hand over the store――I'm sure the old man'll be happy too!」
Erika stuck her thumb up emphatically.
The rare ingredient, the Monster Crab, seemed to have been a formidable enemy, and there were several cuts left on her face and skin, but her expression was incredibly bright and sunny.
Yasu
「Haah～, we sure did do it. It'll only be a relief if the foot traffic returns because of this, though.」
Erika
「It'll come back. Today was good publicity, and the old man's cooking is really tasty anyway!」
Yasu
「I know, right? Why'd the customers suddenly decrease like that?」
Library and the others were talking about things like that, when
Francis
「Ahh～, there you are♪ Well done, you over there! Your cooking was super-yum!」
Erika
「Whoa?! What's with this drunk?!」
A woman in a risqué outfit came tottering over, carrying a large sake bottle in her arms.
Yasu
「Uhiih?! A-Anego! This is Her!! From the Francis Family!」
Erika
「Huh?! This weirdo?!」
The oni girl, Francis, laughed in amusement as she slid an arm around Library's shoulder.
Francis
「Hey, hey. Why don'tcha be my personal chef? I've taken a liking to you☆」
Erika
「Huuuh?!」
Library
「Your invitation is gratifying, but I have a master to serve. I am to return to work from tomorrow on.」
Francis
「That's okay. The Francis Family'll treat you better for sure♪」
Erika
「H-Hey?! What're you doing, inviting him into a gang like it's no big deal?!」
Francis
「's fiiine, fiiine♪ Be a fun, cheerful gang——That's our motto.」
Erika
「There's no fun and cheer in a gang, is there?!」
Yasu
「N-Now, now, Anego, let's be civil here......!」
Library
Seeing Erika and the others making a racket, Library smiled.
This kind of cheerfulness was a good thing every now and then.
But on the other hand.
Library
The earlier conversation between Erika and Yasu was weighing on Library's mind.
No, that question had been in his head constantly, ever since he was preparing for the event.
Library
（The reason for why the café's customers stopped coming......）
Library
（Would the management of the place decline badly enough to necessitate a loan, even though the owner's skill hasn't decreased?）
Somewhere in Senzaki——Kanou's private room.
Kanou
「Shit! Always getting overconfident when I carry things out “cleanly”――」
Kanou
「I don't care anymore! I'll crush them all!!」
Kanou
「That old man who escaped death, and that Erika woman!! That cyborg chef asshole too!!!」
Kanou gruffly spat out his anger.
His young businessmanlike appearance was just a veneer. This was the man's true form.
Despite pretending to be clean on the surface, underneath it all, he was a rotten fiend who worked with evil organizations and committed large numbers of misdeeds.
That was also the case on this matter.
In order to get his hands on the restaurant's land, he had secretly spread bad rumours around the neighbourhood, and put pressure on its regular suppliers.
He had lent money to the restaurant's owner, who was struggling with his finances, and had gotten right to the brink of swiping the café from him.
He had waited for the owner, who loved alcohol, to get drunk, and pushed him down the stairs, causing him to be seriously injured.
Of course, that was to make him unable to participate in the contest, which would bring his store back from the brink of death. However――
Even that plan had come to nothing in the end, thanks to the efforts of Erika and Library.
Kanou
（Hee hee, now that it's come to this, there's no choice......）
Kanou had elected to play his trump card.
Namely, the Shooting Stars, the militant group that he was backing in Shinminato-ku.
Thinking of the “cost” of the cover-up, he had been trying to avoid murder, but――Any more of that would be a waste of time.
Most of the rights to the restaurant had already been secured as collateral.
If he kidnapped the owner, made him sign something, then dropped him into the sea or whatnot――
Subordinate
『Director. A reply from Gondou-san of the Shooting Stars――』
Kanou
「Oh. It's finally here?」
A message came in on Kanou's smart device.
He had made a subordinate set out for Shinminato-ku, to commission them to “take care of” this matter.
Kanou
「Has he gotten a number of soldiers together? That Erika woman seems tough.」
That lippy female mercenary――Her looks and body were first-rate.
He'd give that woman as much loving as he pleased before they “dealt with” her.
It would also be nice to sell her off to a brothel, or torment her so much that it made her regret being born.
However――
Subordinate
『U-Uh...... Gondou-san says he's “severing ties”.』
Subordinate
『That he's got nothing to do with us anymore, and we're not to contact him ever again......』
Kanou
「Huuuh?! What kinda joke is that?!!」
Subordinate
『I-I don't know......!! But Gondou-san was extremely angry......』
Subordinate
『He said, “You picked a fight with a guy you absolutely shouldn't have.”』
Subordinate
『“If you want to die, then die as you please. We have nothing to do with you.”』
Kanou
「What does that mean?! What the hell is he talking about?!!」
Juubei
「Kuku...... Well, old man. It means ya went too far. Now I can't overlook it.」
Kanou
「?!! You――?!! Wh-Who are you? What happened to my guards――?」
Before he knew it, the door was open, and there was a man in the room.
A young, golden-haired man wearing a playful smile.
Juubei
「Guards? Keh keh, all those guys are long dead.」
Juubei
「Well, don't worry. You're gonna join 'em soon.」
Kanou
「S-Say what......?!」
Jittering his hands, he paged the security guard station.
――But, no answer.
Kanou
「Wh-What are you......? Wait...... That hoodlum who was in the restaurant......?!」
Kanou remembered. He had noticed this young man a few times when he visited the café.
Juubei
「Hoodlum? Wrong. I'm The Gangster.」
Kanou
Those jokey words connected with Gondou's strange behaviour just now.
“A guy you absolutely shouldn't pick a fight with,” who even a militant group in Shinminato-ku was afraid of.
“The Gangster”——Kanzaki Juubei, the ex-Taimanin who ruled the Senzaki underworld.
Kanou
「N-N-N-N-No way?!! Y-You're that...... I mean, you, Sir, are that famous――」
Juubei
「Ya didn't know? That shabby little café is my territory.」
Juubei
「Sure, it's a little far from my turf, but――the cooking they serve's not bad at all.」
Juubei
「I'm adding it to my territory specially.」
Kanou
「N-N-No, I had no idea, Sir!! I didn't have the slightest, tiniest intention of going against――」
Kanou
「P-P-P-Please forgive me!!! If it's money you want, I'll pay it!!! Please let me pay!!!」
Kanou pleaded, like he was about to break down in tears and prostrate himself.
――Now he understood perfectly.
The reason that the Shooting Stars had suddenly washed their hands of him was because they knew that this dangerous man was involved.
Juubei
「Hahaha. That's a pity. But “I didn't know” is the biggest sin, in my world.」
Juubei
「So, starting now, you're gonna be payin' the toll for that――」
Kanou
「Hiih!!! Y-You shithead――」
Juubei casually strode over to him――and Kanou fired a gun at his face.
A succession of gunshots.
It was a pistol that had been hidden in his desk.
“At this rate, I'll be killed――In which case, before I am...” he reasoned.
Juubei
「Kuku. Well, well...?」
Kanou
However, the unbelievable had happened.
The bullets, which should have hit Juubei, passed right through him and behind, without inflicting any kind of damage.
Kanou
「A-An Evil Eye......? “Cyclops”......」
He had only heard rumours.
Kanzaki Juubei's Evil Eye ability――“Golden Cyclops”.
It was said that it manipulated metal at will――And, while the Evil Eye was activated, all metal attacks would pass through his body.
Juubei
「Oh, ya knew about that, huh? Then as a prize, I'm gonna letcha die in as much over-the-top agony as you can.」
Kanou
「Agiih?! Giiiiiiiiiiiiiiiih!!!!」
Accompanied by severe pain, Kanou's field of vision became tinged bright red.
His right eyeball had been pulled out by Juubei's kunai.
Juubei
「So that there won't be any more flies swarmin' around here in Senzaki――You could say it's “Gangsters' Law”.」
Kanou
「Hiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiih?!!!」
Kanou fell into despair and screamed.
Within his red-tinted field of vision, Juubei slowly raised his arm to strike.
Rain fell in the city of Senzaki.
Having finished some work, Juubei was getting soaked in the rain as he walked, when
Library
「......Do you not use an umbrella?」
Juubei
「Yo, Mister Cyborg.」
It was the cyborg who had helped Erika and the restaurant, and was strangely adept at cooking.
Juubei knew who he was, and he probably knew Juubei's identity too.
Juubei
「A guy's more handsome when he's soaking in the rain, right? So, whaddya want?」
Library
「......That man, Kanou, appears to have died. By an extremely cruel means of death, I take it.」
Juubei
「Oh, that so?」
Juubei shrugged his shoulders.
“Come to think of it, I've gotten a little hungry,” he remembered.
Library
「Also――About the time when Erika went to the Demon World to get the ingredients.」
Library
「I'm told that when she did battle with that giant crab, an oni warrior woman suddenly appeared and saved her from a predicament. It seems she was hired by somebody.」
Juubei
「Ha! There're some strange guys out there. That all you want?」
Juubei passed by in front of him.
“Shall I stop by that restaurant again on the way back?”
“If Erika's at the café, she'll probably make me some crappy ramen or something”――While he was thinking things like that,
Library
「Fufu, I see.」
The cyborg Taimanin said amusedly, watching Juubei's back as he departed.
Library
「A restaurant where only sweet softies gather, eh?」
